name: Archies Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1990, Archies Ltd is a retailer  of greeting cards, gifts and stationery items[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company deals in Greeting Cards, Gifts and Stationery Products under the brand Archies. It has 20 branches and performs its operations through a network comprising company owned Stores, Franchisee, Distributors and Retailers. It also exports its products.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.49 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -0.67%
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -12.9% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -1.14% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.9.65 Cr.
